title: Crestline Credit Card Program Lineup: Products, Approval Standards and Credit Limits
content:
The Crestline Credit Card is issued by Northgate Bank, N.A. in six products. Northgate Bank underwrites every application; each product has its own approval standard, network and credit-limit range, and a person may hold only one Crestline credit card account (1 account per customer).

## Product sheet

| Product | Northgate approval standard | Network | Credit limit assigned (lowest to highest) | Usable outside Crestline |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Crestline Auto Care Card Starter | FICO score of at least 580 | private label | 300 to 1,000 USD | No |
| Crestline Auto Care Card | FICO score of at least 640 | private label | 500 to 3,000 USD | No |
| Crestline Auto Care Card Preferred | FICO score of at least 700 | private label | 1,500 to 7,500 USD | No |
| Crestline Auto Care Mastercard | FICO score of at least 670 | Mastercard | 1,000 to 5,000 USD | Yes |
| Crestline Auto Care Mastercard Preferred | FICO score of at least 720 | Mastercard | 3,000 to 10,000 USD | Yes |
| Crestline Auto Care World Mastercard | FICO score of at least 760 and annual income of at least 75,000 USD | Mastercard | 5,000 to 25,000 USD | Yes |

Figures as stored: lowest limits 300.0, 500.0, 1500.0, 1000.0, 3000.0 and 5000.0 USD; highest limits 1000.0, 3000.0, 7500.0, 5000.0, 10000.0 and 25000.0 USD, in the order of the table.

## Reading the sheet

- **Credit limit range.** The lowest figure is the smallest limit Northgate assigns on that product; the highest is the most the product carries.
- **Usable outside Crestline.** The three private-label products are accepted at Crestline stores only; the three Mastercard products can also be used at other merchants.
- **Accounts per customer.** The figure is 1 for every product.

## Points of reference

*Is the Crestline Auto Care Card Preferred limited to Crestline stores?* Yes. Its network is private label and it is not accepted outside Crestline, although its credit-limit range (1,500 to 7,500 USD) is higher than that of the Crestline Auto Care Mastercard (1,000 to 5,000 USD).

*Which product carries the widest limit range?* The Crestline Auto Care World Mastercard, from 5,000 to 25,000 USD.
